title: Statistical inference of a competing risks model based on improved adaptive type-II progressive censored data under Gompertz lifetime distribution
summary: This paper studies survival of certain bird species (Zebra Finches) under different food availability conditions. A competing risks model is studied under improved adaptive type-II progressive censoring scheme (IAT-II PCS) referring to this phenomena. Two independent competing causes of failure are considered where lifetime of these failures are assumed to follow Gompertz distribution with unknown scale and shape parameters.
